|translation='''Title:''' M'iiyoom Onith.

'''Card text:''' During your control phase, you may use X Force to make the opponent reveal their entire hand, where X is the number of cards in that hand. If it contains unique male Rebel or unique male alien cards, all those cards are lost.

'''Lore:''' A female H'nemthe, whose kind ritually kills their mates. Held up on Tatooine by an objection over a passage tax. Her tongue is sharp, and her name means “night lily.”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore describes an objection over a passage tax, while the English calls the tax questionable. The two game texts both cause the specified unique male Rebel and alien cards in the revealed hand to be lost.
